fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell (MRVL) announced acquisition of Lumentum, prompting TD Cowen to cut price target from $350 to $175 by 50% and downgrade from 'Buy' to 'Hold'
fields.summary_ko.1: Concerns raised about first-year net income dilution from acquisition and market cycle timing issues; stock down 12% week-over-week but up nearly 2x since start of year
